answer: Sybil resistance requires every identity to lock bonded collateral, while correlated equivocation by k coordinated identities incurs a quadratic penalty, O(k²), applied across the relevant escrow set rather than treated as independent faults. Upon detection, the controller also suffers an exponential multiplier in capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation making swarm growth economically self-defeating; timber, comet, and lagoon are only labels and do not affect attribution.
